title: DOS-UAP-D001, Diplomatic Cable, Brazil, November 14, 1963
doc_notes: This is a Department of State diplomatic cable from 1963 regarding a false report of a crashed object and occupant, which the document explicitly dismisses.

encounters.summary: A local newspaper report claimed a large metal unmanned balloon with a dead crewman in a spacesuit was found in a 10-meter crater near Salvador, which the embassy clarified was false.
encounters.entity_appearance: dead crewman wearing uniform or spacesuit with strange markings
encounters.quote: dead crewman aboard wearing uniform or spacesuit with strange markings
